question: What happens when a student fails to meet course attendance requirements?
answer: When a student fails to meet attendance requirements in a course, the student becomes ineligible to appear in the final examination of that course and will be assigned an F/A grade [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1.22 Failure to meet attendance requirements in a course will].

context.section: 1.22 Failure to meet attendance requirements in a course will
context.text:
1.22 Failure to meet attendance requirements in a course will
render the student ineligible to appear in the final examination of the concerned course.
Consequently, the student will be assigned F/A grade in the course.
